subtitle: 한 시간 돌고 돌아온 대답은 YES

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
새벽 나락 한 시간째네.
호위퀘는 못 해, 나 간다.
cuts.visual_prompt: Slightly low-angle medium shot on a minimal dark-stone Blackrock Depths floor patch against a pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Tauren Druid (she/her) with her leafy wooden staff stowed on her back clutches glowing yellow parchment quest scrolls in panic; on the right, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Undead Paladin (she/her) with a golden shield strapped to her back turns away with half-lidded deadpan eyes, holding a glowing blue Hearthstone.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
파장님, 풀퀘팟이라며!
물퀘랑 윈저퀘 어쩔 거야!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic over-the-shoulder shot from behind the rogue toward the mage against a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon floor shadow. On the left, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Skyborn Mage (she/her) with her crystal staff stowed leans forward furiously pointing and yelling; on the right, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Gnome Rogue (she/her) with dual daggers sheathed at her waist stands sideways looking completely unbothered and blank.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.visual_prompt: Medium front-three-quarter close-up centered on cute 2.5-head chibi SD Gnome Rogue (she/her) against a pure #FFFFFF background, with her daggers sheathed at her waist. She gazes innocently upward with a tiny blank smile, casually tossing a small round cartoon smoke bomb in one hand as faint gray stealth sparkles drift around her.

Extreme big close-up bust shot filling 80% of the frame height against a pure #FFFFFF background, featuring cute 2.5-head chibi SD Skyborn Mage (she/her) on the left and cute 2.5-head chibi SD Tauren Druid (she/her) on the right side-by-side. Both freeze in absolute silent shock with pale faces, tiny trembling dot pupils inside huge blank white eyes, and dropped jaws as tiny cartoon souls float above their heads.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
한 시간 날렸는데 YES?
바로 차단 박는다.
cuts.visual_prompt: Slightly high-angle wide aftermath shot on a minimal dungeon stone floor patch against a pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Tauren Druid (she/her) sits slumped crying over scattered quest scrolls; on the right, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Skyborn Mage (she/her) with her staff stowed angrily slams a red X wooden block stamp onto a floating parchment party list while a fading gray Vanish smoke puff lingers in the empty center.
